notes.title: Update ver. 1.2.0 "Everyone's in on it! Local 4P now available!"
notes.notes:
The 1.2.0 update includes
Local play is now available for 4 players!

It's not that more two players is better than one, or more three players than two, or more four players is better than one... but it's a lot more fun!
But it will be a lot more fun!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43336716/b08577b90462b02a189f794b029e4084bcefe3e5.png[/img]


Let's experience the free and rough action of each player, and the accidental fun created by the physics engine!
Let's experience the free and rough action of each individual, and the accidental fun created by the physics engine together!

notes.title: Update ver.1.1.0 "Added new character and special item"

Then, please continue to enjoy Awakaju~! ^^
